title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
山東鄉試録序
弘治八年當天下賔興賢能
之期山東守臣豫以試事白
鎮守山東都知監太監李〔全〕
巡撫山東都察院右僉都御
史熊〔翀〕咸曰重事境内春夏
不雨恐費涉于民宜慎行之
===
又白於監察御史周〔津〕邵〔蕃〕
亦曰雨不時若舉茲大事宜
慎繼是監察御史曹〔鳳〕来按
茲土實專監臨之寄憫時不
雨百凡之務戒所司務存省
約故民心胥悦未幾天乃雨
〔仁〕等膺聘而来入其境見人
punctuated:
山東鄉試録序

弘治八年，當天下賔興賢能之期，山東守臣豫以試事白鎮守山東都知監太監李〔全〕、巡撫山東都察院右僉都御史熊〔翀〕，咸曰：「重事，境内春夏不雨，恐費涉于民，宜慎行之。」又白於監察御史周〔津〕、邵〔蕃〕，亦曰：「雨不時若，舉茲大事宜慎。」繼是，監察御史曹〔鳳〕来按茲土，實專監臨之寄，憫時不雨，百凡之務，戒所司務存省約，故民心胥悦。未幾，天乃雨。〔仁〕等膺聘而来，入其境，見人
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Shandong Provincial Examination

In the eighth year of Hongzhi (1495), when the time came for honoring and selecting worthy and capable men throughout the realm, Shandong’s territorial officials reported the examination arrangements in advance to Li Quan, Regional Defender of Shandong and Director of the Directorate of Palace Supervision, and Xiong Chong, Grand Coordinator of Shandong and Right Assistant Censor-in-chief of the Censorate. Both said: “This is an important undertaking. Within the province there has been no rain through spring and summer. We fear that the expense may fall upon the people; we should proceed cautiously.” They also reported to Investigating Censors Zhou Jin and Shao Fan, who likewise said: “The rains have not come at the proper times. We should exercise caution in undertaking this great affair.”

After this, Investigating Censor Cao Feng arrived to inspect the province and was entrusted with sole responsibility for supervising the examination. Concerned about the continuing lack of rain, he instructed the officials responsible for every aspect of the undertaking to exercise economy and restraint. The people were therefore all pleased. Before long, rain fell. We—Ren and the others—came in response to invitations to serve; upon entering the province, we saw people…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
皆以得雨為喜然猶未饒洽
也比入院聞垤鸛有聲溽氣
鬱蒸而釀雨明日雨下沛然
又明日初場猶霏微弗止於
是優渥霑足穀秀而實上下
交相歡慶諸士在場屋握管
對雨亦躍躍有喜色著為文
===
章理以澤而詞以潤也迨後
二場天開雨霽士氣倍奮夫
陰陽氣上薄為雨乘空而墜
驟則為涷小則為霢霂皆足
以澤物我
國家養士於學校而取之以科
目優其廩復其家給人以代
punctuated:
皆以得雨為喜，然猶未饒洽也。比入院，聞垤鸛有聲，溽氣鬱蒸而釀雨。明日，雨下沛然；又明日，初場，猶霏微弗止。於是優渥霑足，穀秀而實，上下交相歡慶。諸士在場屋握管對雨，亦躍躍有喜色，著為文章，理以澤而詞以潤也。迨後二場，天開雨霽，士氣倍奮。
夫陰陽氣上薄為雨，乘空而墜，驟則為涷，小則為霢霂，皆足以澤物。我國家養士於學校，而取之以科目，優其廩，復其家，給人以代
translation_en:
…everyone rejoiced at receiving rain, though it had not yet thoroughly soaked the ground. By the time we entered the examination compound, we heard storks calling on the mounds; humid vapors gathered and steamed, brewing rain. The following day, rain poured down abundantly. The next day, during the first examination session, a fine drizzle still fell without ceasing. Thus the land was generously watered and thoroughly drenched, and the grain flowered and filled out. High and low alike rejoiced together. The candidates in the examination halls, brushes in hand as they faced the rain, likewise showed eager delight. This found expression in their compositions: their reasoning was enriched and their language imbued with freshness. By the latter two sessions, the skies had cleared and the rain had ceased, and the candidates’ spirits were redoubled.
Now, the vapors of yin and yang rise and meet to form rain, which falls through the air. When sudden and heavy, it is a downpour; when light, a drizzle. Both suffice to nourish all things. Our dynasty nurtures scholars in its schools and selects them through the examinations. It provides them with generous grain stipends, exempts their households from service obligations, and supplies people to serve in their stead…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
其使令愛護匡翼靡不周至
正猶天之於嘉穀既沃以凍
又益以霡霂而所以資其發
生者厚也况諸齊魯之士生
長聖賢之鄉私淑乎時雨之
化而脩之已者亦自有素焉
則夫今日之登名是選信非
===
偶然耶盍亦思乎士之未遇
固如穀之未成日望乎雨澤
之加及其既遇則如穀之已
熟人將仰其澤以為生矣苟
徒侥倖於一得不思推厥素
如雨之施以澤物寧不有孤
國家養士之盛心哉故古之君
punctuated: 其使令，愛護匡翼，靡不周至。正猶天之於嘉穀，既沃以凍，又益以霡霂，而所以資其發生者厚也。况諸齊魯之士，生長聖賢之鄉，私淑乎時雨之化，而脩之已者亦自有素焉，則夫今日之登名是選，信非偶然耶？盍亦思乎？士之未遇，固如穀之未成，日望乎雨澤之加；及其既遇，則如穀之已熟，人將仰其澤以為生矣。苟徒侥倖於一得，不思推厥素，如雨之施以澤物，寧不有孤國家養士之盛心哉？故古之君
translation_en:
…their service duties. In cherishing, protecting, supporting, and assisting them, nothing is left unattended. This is just like Heaven’s treatment of fine grain: having watered it with heavy rain [?], it adds a gentle drizzle, generously supplying what enables it to sprout and grow. Moreover, you scholars of Qi and Lu were born and raised in the homeland of sages and worthies. You have learned indirectly from their transforming influence, like timely rain, and have long cultivated yourselves [?]. Surely, then, your names’ appearance among those selected today is no accident?

Should you not also reflect on this? Before scholars meet with opportunity, they are indeed like grain not yet grown to maturity, daily hoping for the nourishing rain to fall. Once they have met with opportunity, however, they are like ripened grain: people will depend upon their beneficence for their livelihood. If you merely count yourselves fortunate in this one success and do not think of extending your longstanding cultivation to benefit others, as rain nourishes all things, would you not betray the state’s generous intention in nurturing scholars? Thus, the gentlemen of antiquity…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
子不以登名爲榮而以成功
爲憮繼自今諸士將爲時所
用必隨厥任盡厥職居民牧
則爲百里蔦之隨車雨以蘇
一郡一邑之枯槁司風紀則
爲顔魯公之御史雨以洗一
道之寃滯處
===
廟堂則爲商相之三日雨以慰
四海九州之仰望飛甘灑澍
作休徵於治世上有以啓沃
乎
君心下有以膏澤乎民生此則大
丈夫之事固諸士之所當自
負亦
punctuated: 子不以登名爲榮，而以成功爲憮。繼自今，諸士將爲時所用，必隨厥任，盡厥職。居民牧，則爲百里蔦之隨車雨，以蘇一郡一邑之枯槁；司風紀，則爲顔魯公之御史雨，以洗一道之寃滯；處廟堂，則爲商相之三日雨，以慰四海九州之仰望。飛甘灑澍，作休徵於治世，上有以啓沃乎君心，下有以膏澤乎民生。此則大丈夫之事，固諸士之所當自負，亦
translation_en: …the gentleman does not regard having his name listed among the successful candidates as an honor, but takes the accomplishment of his work as his concern [?]. Henceforth, when you gentlemen are employed in the service of the age, you must fulfill your duties according to your appointments. Serving as shepherds of the people, you should be like the rain that followed the carriage of Baili Niao [?], reviving what has withered in a prefecture or county. Charged with censorial oversight, you should be like the “Censor’s rain” of Yan, Duke of Lu, washing away the unresolved injustices of a circuit. Serving at court, you should be like the three days’ rain of the Shang minister, fulfilling the hopes of all within the Four Seas and the Nine Provinces. Let sweet, timely rain fall, becoming an auspicious sign in an age of good government: above, enlightening and nourishing the ruler’s mind; below, enriching the people’s livelihood. This is the work of a man of great resolve, a responsibility that you gentlemen should assuredly take upon yourselves, and also …

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
國家之有待於我者也〔仁〕〔睎〕於
知言辱諸士為集門杞梓敢
托諸雨致祝䫉之意以僭序
小錄之成凡有事于茲者〔仁〕
與教諭張〔澤〕為考試官教諭
張〔瀚〕朱〔文魁〕王〔翰〕邵〔清〕訓導
陸〔紳〕李〔士元〕楊〔勷〕為同考試
===
官左布政使吳〔琨〕按察使趙
〔鶴齡〕左參政林〔元甫〕僉事馮
〔鎬〕則提調監試於內右布政
使柳〔淳〕左右參政張〔銳〕劉〔聰〕
副使劉〔福〕陳〔璧〕廖〔中〕王〔紳〕郝
〔志義〕左右參議杜〔整〕周〔紘〕僉
事陳〔寬〕鈕〔清〕陳〔嘉謨〕胡〔富〕則
punctuated:
國家之有待於我者也。〔仁〕〔睎〕於知言，辱諸士為集門杞梓，敢托諸雨致祝䫉之意，以僭序小錄之成。
凡有事于茲者，〔仁〕與教諭張〔澤〕為考試官；教諭張〔瀚〕、朱〔文魁〕、王〔翰〕、邵〔清〕，訓導陸〔紳〕、李〔士元〕、楊〔勷〕為同考試官。左布政使吳〔琨〕、按察使趙〔鶴齡〕、左參政林〔元甫〕、僉事馮〔鎬〕則提調監試於內；右布政使柳〔淳〕、左右參政張〔銳〕、劉〔聰〕，副使劉〔福〕、陳〔璧〕、廖〔中〕、王〔紳〕、郝〔志義〕，左右參議杜〔整〕、周〔紘〕，僉事陳〔寬〕、鈕〔清〕、陳〔嘉謨〕、胡〔富〕則
translation_en:
…is also what the state expects of us. I, Ren 仁, aspire to understand words [?] and am honored to have these gentlemen as fine timber gathered at our gate [?]. I venture to invoke the rains to convey my good wishes [?], presumptuously supplying a preface upon the completion of this modest record.
Those who took part in this undertaking were as follows. Ren and Zhang Ze, Instructor, served as Examiners. Zhang Han, Zhu Wenkui, Wang Han, and Shao Qing, all Instructors, and Lu Shen, Li Shiyuan, and Yang Rang, all Assistant Instructors, served as Associate Examiners.
Wu Kun, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner; Zhao Heling, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner; Lin Yuanfu, Left Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner; and Feng Gao, Assistant Provincial Surveillance Commissioner, managed arrangements and supervised the examination within the compound.
Liu Chun, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner; Zhang Rui and Liu Cong, Left and Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioners; Liu Fu, Chen Bi, Liao Zhong, Wang Shen, and Hao Zhiyi, Provincial Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Du Zheng and Zhou Hong, Left and Right Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioners; and Chen Kuan, Niu Qing, Chen Jiamo, and Hu Fu, Assistant Provincial Surveillance Commissioners, for their part …

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
防衛贊成於外至於印卷受
卷而下亦各擇人以供事與
試之士簡拔於提學副使楊
文卿者千三百人来自遼陽
者百八十人遵
制額取七十五人刻文之醇者
二十餘篇皆王散珠聯如瑞
===
雨焉
直隸蘇州府吳縣儒學教諭
李仁謹序
punctuated:
防衛贊成於外。至於印卷、受卷而下，亦各擇人以供事。與試之士，簡拔於提學副使楊文卿者千三百人，来自遼陽者百八十人。遵制額取七十五人，刻文之醇者二十餘篇，皆王散珠聯，如瑞雨焉。
直隸蘇州府吳縣儒學教諭李仁謹序。
translation_en:
…provided security and assistance outside. For printing and receiving examination papers and the subordinate duties, suitable men were likewise selected for each task. Of the candidates sitting the examination, 1,300 had been selected by Yang Wenqing, Vice Commissioner serving as Education Intendant, and 180 came from Liaoyang. In accordance with the imperially prescribed quota, seventy-five men were selected. More than twenty essays of refined quality were engraved for printing, all like scattered jade and strung pearls [?], like auspicious rain.
Preface respectfully written by Li Ren, Instructor of the Confucian School of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region.

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:

punctuated:
弘治八年山東鄉試

監臨官
巡按山東監察御史曹鳳〔鳴岐，河南新蔡縣人，辛丑進士〕。

提調官
山東等處承宣布政使司左布政使吳珉〔廷振，山西靈石縣人，己丑進士〕。
山東等處承宣布政使司左叅政林元甫〔秉仁，福建莆田縣人，乙未進士〕。

監試官
山東等處提刑按察司按察使趙鶴齡〔永年，四川瀘州衛人，乙未進士〕。

直隸滁州來安縣儒學教諭張澤〔朝與，福建莆田縣人，庚子貢士〕。

同考試官
直隸淮安府邳州宿遷縣儒學教諭張瀚〔文淵，福建候官縣人，癸卯貢士〕。
直隸蘇州府長洲縣儒學教諭朱𢙣〔汝貴，福建莆田縣人，癸卯貢士〕。
湖廣黃州府黃岡縣儒學教諭王翰〔廷用，應天府江寧縣人，己酉貢士〕。

translation_en:
Shandong Provincial Examination, the Eighth Year of Hongzhi (1495)

Supervising Official
Cao Feng, Investigating Censor on an inspection tour of Shandong, had the courtesy name Mingqi and was from Xincai County, Henan. He became a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) in the xinchou year.

Proctors
Wu Min, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of the Shandong Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Tingzhen and was from Lingshi County, Shanxi. He became a metropolitan graduate in the jichou year.
Lin Yuanfu, Left Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner of the Shandong Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Bingren and was from Putian County, Fujian. He became a metropolitan graduate in the yiwei year.

Examination Monitoring Officials
Zhao Heling, Surveillance Commissioner of the Shandong Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Yongnian and was from Luzhou Guard, Sichuan. He became a metropolitan graduate in the yiwei year.
Feng Gao, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of the Shandong Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Dajing and was from Xinyang Subprefecture, Henan. He became a metropolitan graduate in the wuxu year.

Examiners
Li Ren, Instructor at the Confucian School of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered territory, had the courtesy name Shanzhang and was from Putian County, Fujian. He became a tribute student (gongshi) in the dingyou year.
Zhang Ze, Instructor at the Confucian School of Lai'an County, Chuzhou Subprefecture, in the directly administered territory, had the courtesy name Chaoyu and was from Putian County, Fujian. He became a tribute student in the gengzi year.

Associate Examiners
Zhang Han, Instructor at the Confucian School of Suqian County, Pizhou Subprefecture, Huai'an Prefecture, in the directly administered territory, had the courtesy name Wenyuan and was from Houguan County [?], Fujian. He became a tribute student in the guimao year.
Zhu E, Instructor at the Confucian School of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered territory, had the courtesy name Rugui and was from Putian County, Fujian. He became a tribute student in the guimao year.
Wang Han, Instructor at the Confucian School of Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang, had the courtesy name Tingyong and was from Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture. He became a tribute student in the jiyou year.
Shao Qing, Instructor at the Confucian School of Dehua County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi, had the courtesy name Shiying and was from Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture. He became a tribute student in the renzi year.
Lu Shen, Assistant Instructor at the Confucian School of Fengxin County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, had the courtesy name Jianshen and was from Cixi County, Zhejiang. He became a tribute student in the jiyou year.

text:

受卷官

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
天下有道則庶人不議
庸德之行庸言之謹有所不足不敢不勉
有餘不敢盡
多助之至天下順之
易
上下交而其志同也
九五井冽寒泉食象曰寒泉之食中正也
===
夫易聖人之所以極深而研幾也
有大者不可以盈故受之以謙
書
惟動丕應徯志
惟暨乃僚罔不同心以匡乃辟
王厥有成命治民今休王先服殷御事比
介于我有周御事節性惟日其邁王
敬作所不可不敬德我不可不監于
有夏亦不可不監于有殷
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

天下有道，則庶人不議。

庸德之行，庸言之謹，有所不足，不敢不勉；有餘，不敢盡。

多助之至，天下順之。

易

上下交而其志同也。

九五，井冽，寒泉食。象曰：「寒泉之食，中正也。」

夫易，聖人之所以極深而研幾也。

有大者不可以盈，故受之以謙。

書

惟動丕應徯志。

惟暨乃僚，罔不同心，以匡乃辟。

王厥有成命治民，今休。王先服殷御事，比介于我有周御事，節性惟日其邁。王敬作所，不可不敬德。我不可不監于有夏，亦不可不監于有殷。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

When the Way prevails under Heaven, the common people do not debate affairs of government.

In practicing ordinary virtues and exercising care in ordinary speech, wherever one falls short, one dares not fail to exert oneself; wherever one has a surplus, one dares not expend it all.

When support reaches its fullest extent, all under Heaven submit to him.

Book of Changes

Those above and those below communicate, and their purposes are the same.

Nine in the fifth place: The well is clear and cold; its spring water is fit to drink. The Image commentary says: “The cold spring water is fit to drink because this line is central and correctly positioned.”

The Changes is the means by which the sages plumb the depths and investigate the beginnings of things.

One who possesses greatness must not become full of himself; therefore, Great Possession is followed by Modesty.

Book of Documents

Whenever you act, respond fully to what the people hope for.

Together with your colleagues, be united in purpose, without exception, in supporting and correcting your sovereign.

The king has received the established mandate to govern the people, and now there is good fortune. Let the king first employ the officers of Yin, bringing them alongside our officers of Zhou to assist them, so that, disciplining their dispositions, they may advance daily. Let the king reverently establish his position; he must not fail to honor virtue. We must take warning from Xia, and we must also take warning from Yin.

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
爾克敬典在德時乃罔不變允升于大猷
詩
知子之来之雜佩以贈之知子之順之雜
佩以問之知子之好之雜佩以報之
雨我公田遂及我私
威儀抑抑德音秩秩無怨無惡率由羣匹
受福無疆四方之綱之綱之紀燕及
朋友百辟卿士媚于天子不解于位
民之攸塈
===
天命降監下民有嚴
春秋
公及齊侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯
會王世子于首止　諸侯盟于首止
〔僖公五年公會宰周公齊侯宋子衛〕
侯鄭伯許男曹伯于葵丘　諸侯盟
于葵丘〔僖公九年〕
三月作丘甲〔成公元年〕
公會晉侯宋公衛侯曹伯莒子邾子滕子
punctuated:
爾克敬典在德，時乃罔不變，允升于大猷。

詩
知子之来之，雜佩以贈之；知子之順之，雜佩以問之；知子之好之，雜佩以報之。
雨我公田，遂及我私。
威儀抑抑，德音秩秩。無怨無惡，率由羣匹。受福無疆，四方之綱。之綱之紀，燕及朋友。百辟卿士，媚于天子。不解于位，民之攸塈。
天命降監，下民有嚴。

春秋
公及齊侯、宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯，會王世子于首止。諸侯盟于首止。〔僖公五年。公會宰周公、齊侯、宋子、衛〕侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯于葵丘。諸侯盟于葵丘。〔僖公九年〕
三月，作丘甲。〔成公元年〕
公會晉侯、宋公、衛侯、曹伯、莒子、邾子、滕子
translation_en:
If you can reverently uphold the established norms and ground yourself in virtue, then none will fail to change, and you will truly advance to the great Way.

Book of Odes
Knowing that you will come, I give you assorted girdle pendants. Knowing your goodwill, I offer you assorted girdle pendants in greeting. Knowing your affection, I give you assorted girdle pendants in return.
Let rain fall on our public fields, and then reach our private fields.
Your bearing is dignified; your virtuous reputation is well ordered. Without resentment or ill will, you follow the example of your peers. Receiving blessings without limit, you are the guiding cord of the four quarters. Their guiding cord and ordering thread, you extend your peace to your friends. The many lords, ministers, and officers cherish the Son of Heaven. Unflagging in their offices, they provide the people with repose.
Heaven’s mandate descends in watchfulness; the people below stand in awe.

Spring and Autumn Annals
The Duke of Lu, together with the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao, met the king’s heir apparent at Shouzhi. The feudal lords concluded a covenant at Shouzhi. [Fifth year of Duke Xi.]
The Duke of Lu met the Chief Minister, the Duke of Zhou, the Marquis of Qi, the Viscount of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao at Kuiqiu. The feudal lords concluded a covenant at Kuiqiu. [Ninth year of Duke Xi.] [The transcription places the opening of this entry within the preceding annotation, splitting the title “Marquis of Wei” across the annotation boundary; its placement is doubtful [?].]
In the third month, an armor levy was instituted on the qiu land units. [First year of Duke Cheng.]
The Duke of Lu met with the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, and the Viscount of Teng …

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
薛伯杞伯小邾子齊世子光伐鄭同
盟于戲〔襄公九年〕
西狩獲麟〔哀公十四年〕
禮記
凡居民材必因天地寒煖燥濕廣谷大川
異制民生其間者異俗剛柔輕重遲
速異齊五味異和器械異制衣服異
宜脩其教不易其俗齊其政不易其
宜
===
故國有禮官有御事有職禮有序
脩身及家平均天下
父子有親而後君臣有正
論
君子之學以潤身為本
第貳場
詔誥表
擬漢令諸儒講五經同異詔〔甘露三年〕
擬唐以裴度為中書侍郎同平章事誥〔元〕
punctuated:
薛伯、杞伯、小邾子、齊世子光伐鄭，同盟于戲〔襄公九年〕。
西狩獲麟〔哀公十四年〕。
禮記
凡居民材，必因天地寒煖燥濕、廣谷大川，異制。民生其間者，異俗，剛柔輕重遲速異齊，五味異和，器械異制，衣服異宜。脩其教，不易其俗；齊其政，不易其宜。
故國有禮，官有御，事有職，禮有序。
脩身及家，平均天下。
父子有親，而後君臣有正。
論
君子之學，以潤身為本。
第貳場
詔誥表
擬漢令諸儒講五經同異詔〔甘露三年〕。
擬唐以裴度為中書侍郎同平章事誥〔元〕
translation_en:
…the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi, the Viscount of Xiao Zhu, and Guang, heir apparent of Qi, attacked Zheng and together entered into a covenant at Xi. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xiang〕
During a hunt in the west, a qilin was captured. 〔Fourteenth year of Duke Ai〕

Record of Rites
Whenever settling the people and assessing the land’s resources, one must adapt to the conditions of heaven and earth—cold and warmth, dryness and dampness, broad valleys and great rivers—and establish differing arrangements. The people born amid these conditions have different customs. Their dispositions differ in firmness and gentleness, gravity and lightness, slowness and quickness; they blend the five flavors differently, make implements differently, and find different clothing suitable. Refine their instruction without changing their customs; bring their government into order without changing what suits them.
Thus, the state has rites; officials have their responsibilities; affairs have their assigned duties; and rites have their proper sequence.
Cultivate oneself, extend this to one’s family, and bring equitable order to all under Heaven.
Only after there is affection between father and son can there be rectitude between ruler and minister.

Discourse
The learning of the noble man takes the refinement of his own person as its foundation.

Second Session
Imperial Proclamations, Letters of Appointment, and Memorials
Compose, as if for the Han dynasty, an imperial proclamation ordering the scholars to discuss agreements and differences among the Five Classics. 〔Third year of Ganlu〕
Compose, as if for the Tang dynasty, a letter appointing Pei Du Vice Director of the Secretariat and Joint Manager of Affairs of the Secretariat-Chancellery. 〔Yuan…〕

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
和十年
擬宋以周必大為樞密使謝表〔淳熙十一年〕
判語〔五條〕
濫設官吏
制書有違
隱蔽差役
服舍違式
飛報軍情
第叁塲
===
策五道
問天之生民必有出類之才起而君師之
君以治之師以教之不越乎五倫之
敦而已稽之於經蓋可見也洪惟我
太祖高皇帝肇造區夏條成大誥三編
太宗文皇帝纘承丕緒首製孝順事實為善陰
騭二書
宣宗章皇帝繼志述事纘述五倫書頒之天下
無非所以敦五倫也
punctuated:
和十年。
擬宋以周必大為樞密使謝表〔淳熙十一年〕。
判語〔五條〕：濫設官吏；制書有違；隱蔽差役；服舍違式；飛報軍情。
第叁塲
策五道
問：天之生民，必有出類之才，起而君師之。君以治之，師以教之，不越乎五倫之敦而已。稽之於經，蓋可見也。洪惟我太祖高皇帝肇造區夏，條成《大誥》三編。太宗文皇帝纘承丕緒，首製《孝順事實》《為善陰騭》二書。宣宗章皇帝繼志述事，纘述《五倫書》，頒之天下，無非所以敦五倫也。
translation_en:
…the tenth year of Yuanhe.
Compose a memorial of thanks in the persona of Zhou Bida of the Song upon his appointment as Military Affairs Commissioner. 〔Eleventh year of Chunxi〕
Legal judgments 〔five items〕: Unauthorized establishment of official posts and appointment of functionaries; violations of imperial edicts; concealment to evade service obligations; clothing and dwellings that contravene prescribed standards; urgent reporting of military intelligence.
Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: When Heaven brings forth the people, there must be persons of outstanding ability who arise to serve as their rulers and teachers. As rulers they govern them; as teachers they instruct them. This amounts to nothing beyond strengthening the Five Relationships. That this is so can be seen by consulting the Classics. We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao founded the realm and compiled the Grand Pronouncements (Da gao) in three parts, arranged by article. Emperor Taizong Wen succeeded to the great enterprise and first produced the two books, True Accounts of Filial Obedience (Xiaoshun shishi) and Doing Good and Its Hidden Recompense (Weishan yinzhi). Emperor Xuanzong Zhang carried forward their intentions and undertakings, compiling the Book of the Five Relationships (Wulun shu) and promulgating it throughout the realm. All these were means of strengthening the Five Relationships.…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
英宗睿皇帝又有大明一統誌之頒其紀名宦
人物烈女亦皆五倫攸繫但
大誥所載多垂戒後世之事其敦五倫之條
何見
爲善陰隲所載多垂訓後世之實其敦五倫
之事何在
孝順事實專言孝也其中亦有兼於餘倫者
乎
五倫書備載嘉言善行也其中何獨詳於君
臣之倫乎
大明一統誌所載名宦人物烈女克盡五倫之
道者不可指數其在山東最彰著者
幾人諸士子佩服
聖訓有年矣願悉陳之
問孝經小學之書皆紀載先王之所以脩
身齊家治國平天下之本孝經成於
曾子門人之手而朱子爲之刋誤小
學雜出於曲禮少儀內則弟子職諸
punctuated:
英宗睿皇帝又有《大明一統誌》之頒，其紀名宦、人物、烈女，亦皆五倫攸繫。但《大誥》所載，多垂戒後世之事，其敦五倫之條何見？《爲善陰隲》所載，多垂訓後世之實，其敦五倫之事何在？《孝順事實》專言孝也，其中亦有兼於餘倫者乎？《五倫書》備載嘉言善行也，其中何獨詳於君臣之倫乎？《大明一統誌》所載名宦、人物、烈女，克盡五倫之道者不可指數，其在山東最彰著者幾人？諸士子佩服聖訓有年矣，願悉陳之。
問：孝經、小學之書，皆紀載先王之所以脩身、齊家、治國、平天下之本。《孝經》成於曾子門人之手，而朱子爲之刋誤；《小學》雜出於《曲禮》《少儀》《內則》《弟子職》諸
translation_en:
Emperor Yingzong Rui also promulgated the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Great Ming. Its accounts of eminent officials, notable figures, and exemplary women likewise all bear upon the Five Relationships. Yet the Great Pronouncements chiefly records matters intended to admonish later generations: where are its provisions for strengthening the Five Relationships to be found? Doing Good and Hidden Merit chiefly records actual deeds intended to instruct later generations: where does it present deeds that strengthen the Five Relationships? Accounts of Filial Piety and Obedience speaks specifically of filial piety: does it also contain material concerning the other relationships? The Book of the Five Relationships comprehensively records admirable sayings and good deeds: why does it treat the relationship between ruler and minister alone in particular detail? Among the eminent officials, notable figures, and exemplary women recorded in the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Great Ming, those who fully fulfilled the Way of the Five Relationships are too numerous to count. How many were especially distinguished in Shandong? You candidates have respectfully embraced the imperial teachings for years; please set all this forth in full.
Question: The Classic of Filial Piety and Elementary Learning both record the foundations upon which the former kings cultivated themselves, regulated their families, governed their states, and brought peace to all under Heaven. The Classic of Filial Piety was completed by the disciples of Zengzi, and Master Zhu corrected its errors. Elementary Learning draws material from the various chapters entitled “Summary of Ritual,” “Minor Rules of Deportment,” “Domestic Regulations,” “Duties of Disciples,” …

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
篇而朱子為之蒐輯故今皆授之童
蒙資其講習誠大切要之書也諸士
子誦習有年試相與講明之孝經六
章之書果皆舊文而無離析增加之
失歟七章以後又皆何人所作而無
戾於孔曾傳受之意歟孔壁所藏者
何本河間王所得者何書閨門一章
不知何人所去其所去者是歟非歟
小學有內篇有外篇內篇所紀者何
===
道外篇所紀者何事抑二篇何以有
內外之別乎或者謂立教明倫敬身
為小學之綱領而稽古非綱領何以
入於內篇歟嘉言善行何以為小學
外篇而內篇何莫非嘉言善行歟願
為我言之
問古之聖賢世系之遠惟孔氏為最雖堯
舜之盛不能過也遡其先世為宋人
中葉遷魯遂為魯人歷十四世而生
punctuated:
篇，而朱子為之蒐輯，故今皆授之童蒙，資其講習，誠大切要之書也。諸士子誦習有年，試相與講明之。《孝經》六章之書，果皆舊文，而無離析增加之失歟？七章以後，又皆何人所作，而無戾於孔曾傳受之意歟？孔壁所藏者何本？河間王所得者何書？閨門一章，不知何人所去，其所去者是歟非歟？《小學》有內篇，有外篇，內篇所紀者何道？外篇所紀者何事？抑二篇何以有內外之別乎？或者謂立教、明倫、敬身為《小學》之綱領，而稽古非綱領，何以入於內篇歟？嘉言、善行何以為《小學》外篇，而內篇何莫非嘉言、善行歟？願為我言之。
問：古之聖賢，世系之遠，惟孔氏為最，雖堯舜之盛，不能過也。遡其先世，為宋人，中葉遷魯，遂為魯人，歷十四世而生
translation_en:
…chapters, which Master Zhu compiled and collected. Thus both books are now taught to young beginners to support their study and practice; they are indeed books of the greatest importance. You candidates have recited and studied them for years; let us now elucidate them together. Are the six chapters of the Classic of Filial Piety all genuinely the old text, free from errors of division or addition? Who composed the material from the seventh chapter onward, and is it consistent with the meaning transmitted by Confucius to Zengzi? Which version was concealed in the wall of Confucius’s house? What text did the Prince of Hejian obtain? We do not know who removed the chapter “Within the Inner Quarters”; was its removal right or wrong? Elementary Learning has Inner and Outer sections. What principles do the Inner sections record, and what affairs do the Outer sections record? Why, moreover, are these two divisions distinguished as Inner and Outer? Some say that “Establishing Instruction,” “Clarifying Human Relationships,” and “Conducting Oneself with Reverence” constitute the essential framework of Elementary Learning. If “Examining Antiquity” is not part of that framework, why is it included in the Inner sections? Why do “Admirable Sayings” and “Good Deeds” constitute the Outer sections of Elementary Learning, when everything in the Inner sections is likewise an admirable saying or a good deed? Please explain these matters to me.
Question: Among the sages and worthies of antiquity, the Kong lineage is foremost in the extent of its genealogy; even the illustrious lineages of Yao and Shun cannot surpass it. Tracing its ancestors, we find that they were people of Song. In an intermediate generation they migrated to Lu and thus became people of Lu. Fourteen generations passed before the birth of…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
孔子源亦遠矣可追論歟然源遠則
流長沒其流也自伋以後無代無人
無人弗耀戰國時有為齊相者有為
魏相者有為秦博士者其人何名炎
漢時有遷大將軍者有拜太師者有
襲封關內侯者其人何飭歷晉宋梁
隋間或為奉聖亭侯後改封崇聖侯
曰奉曰崇果有輕重乎或為恭聖侯
後改封紹聖侯曰恭曰紹亦有差等
===
乎及唐宋時或對策高第或狀元及
第或明經及第一時文運盖莫盛也
可得聞歟或以剛毅直諒名或以操
行介潔稱或以介潔不阿許一時節
義盖莫尚也可歷指歟世之論常者
必曰豐於前者嗇於後如孔子之亶
生不為不豐而其後又自不嗇果堯
舜獨憔於孔子乎抑別有其說乎諸
生挺生東魯幸與孔氏同邦其世系
punctuated: 孔子，源亦遠矣，可追論歟？然源遠則流長，沒其流也，自伋以後，無代無人，無人弗耀。戰國時，有為齊相者，有為魏相者，有為秦博士者，其人何名？炎漢時，有遷大將軍者，有拜太師者，有襲封關內侯者，其人何飭？歷晉宋梁隋間，或為奉聖亭侯，後改封崇聖侯，曰奉曰崇，果有輕重乎？或為恭聖侯，後改封紹聖侯，曰恭曰紹，亦有差等乎？及唐宋時，或對策高第，或狀元及第，或明經及第，一時文運盖莫盛也，可得聞歟？或以剛毅直諒名，或以操行介潔稱，或以介潔不阿許，一時節義盖莫尚也，可歷指歟？世之論常者必曰：「豐於前者，嗇於後。」如孔子之亶生，不為不豐，而其後又自不嗇，果堯舜獨憔於孔子乎？抑別有其說乎？諸生挺生東魯，幸與孔氏同邦，其世系
translation_en:
…Confucius: his lineage, too, reaches far back. Can it be traced and discussed? Yet a distant source makes for a long stream. As for the course of that stream [?], from Ji onward, no generation lacked men of distinction, and none failed to shine. During the Warring States period, one served as Counsellor-in-chief of Qi, another as Counsellor-in-chief of Wei, and another as an Erudite of Qin. What were their names? During the Han dynasty, associated with the virtue of fire, one was promoted to General-in-chief, another was appointed Grand Preceptor, and another inherited the title of Marquis Within the Passes. What distinctions did these men possess [?]? Through the Jin, Song, Liang, and Sui dynasties, one bore the title Marquis of Fengsheng Village, later changed to Marquis of Chongsheng. Between “Serving the Sage” and “Exalting the Sage,” was there really a difference in weight? Another bore the title Marquis of Gongsheng, later changed to Marquis of Shaosheng. Between “Revering the Sage” and “Continuing the Sage,” was there likewise a difference in standing?

By the Tang and Song dynasties, some earned high rankings for their answers to policy questions, some passed as the top examination graduate, and some passed the examination in elucidating the classics. Literary fortunes in those days could hardly have flourished more greatly. May we hear about them? Some were renowned for firmness, resolution, uprightness, and trustworthiness; some were praised for principled and pure conduct; and some were esteemed for integrity, purity, and refusal to bend to others. Their moral constancy and righteousness could hardly have been surpassed in their time. Can you identify them individually?

Those who discuss the ordinary patterns of the world invariably say: “Abundance in earlier generations brings scarcity in later ones.” With the birth of Confucius, the abundance could scarcely have been greater, yet his descendants likewise suffered no scarcity. Were Yao and Shun alone truly diminished beside Confucius [?], or is there another explanation? You students have emerged as outstanding men in eastern Lu and are fortunate to share the homeland of the Kong lineage. Its genealogy…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
人物知之素矣毋吝告我
問
人莫難於知人亦莫難於自知知人則
哲堯所難也何敢望回孔子與焉後
世無帝堯之智子貢之識而立論以
方人舉人以自況誇誕者不免失於
自高溺愛者不免失於過許豈能無
罅隙之可議哉敢以史冊所紀者與
諸士商之三顧馳驅者嘗以管樂自
居三朝勤勞者嘗以伊周自託�János復
===
之君或擬之於韓彭罪謫之守或擬
之於頗牧忘身殉國者目為魏徵似
矣碩德重望者累似乎馮道平齊定
薊者目為韓信肖矣搯虱高談者累
肖乎孔明或贊金世宗為堯舜或方
晉武帝為桓靈其論孰優或自況於
文宣或自愧於赧獻其見孰當澄之
不清淆之不濁視顏子為孰賢舉賢
用能厲兵訓卒視子房為孰勝考覈
punctuated:
人物，知之素矣，毋吝告我。

問：人莫難於知人，亦莫難於自知。知人則哲，堯所難也；何敢望回，孔子與焉。後世無帝堯之智、子貢之識，而立論以方人，舉人以自況，誇誕者不免失於自高，溺愛者不免失於過許，豈能無罅隙之可議哉？敢以史冊所紀者與諸士商之。三顧馳驅者，嘗以管樂自居；三朝勤勞者，嘗以伊周自託；�János復之君，或擬之於韓彭；罪謫之守，或擬之於頗牧。忘身殉國者，目為魏徵似矣；碩德重望者，累似乎馮道。平齊定薊者，目為韓信肖矣；搯虱高談者，累肖乎孔明。或贊金世宗為堯舜，或方晉武帝為桓靈，其論孰優？或自況於文宣，或自愧於赧獻，其見孰當？澄之不清，淆之不濁，視顏子為孰賢？舉賢用能，厲兵訓卒，視子房為孰勝？考覈
translation_en:
…and notable people, with whom you have long been familiar. Do not hesitate to tell me.

Question: Nothing is harder than knowing others, and nothing is harder than knowing oneself. Knowing others constitutes wisdom: even Yao found this difficult. “How could I dare hope to equal Hui?”—Confucius approved this admission. People of later ages lack Emperor Yao’s wisdom and Zigong’s discernment, yet pronounce comparisons between people and invoke others as counterparts to themselves. The boastful inevitably err by exalting themselves, while those blinded by affection inevitably err through excessive praise. How could their judgments be free of flaws open to criticism? I venture to discuss with you gentlemen some cases recorded in the histories.

The man who exerted himself in service after receiving three visits once compared himself to Guan Zhong and Yue Yi. The man who labored diligently through three reigns once likened himself to Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou. A ruler associated with restoration [preceding text corrupt: �János復, ?] was compared by some to Han Xin and Peng Yue; a prefect banished for an offense was compared by some to Lian Po and Li Mu. The man who sacrificed himself for his country was regarded as resembling Wei Zheng; the man of great virtue and high standing was tainted by a resemblance to Feng Dao. The man who pacified Qi and subdued Ji was regarded as resembling Han Xin; the man who picked lice while discoursing loftily was faulted for resembling Kongming.

Some praised Emperor Shizong of Jin as a Yao or Shun; others compared Emperor Wu of Jin to Emperors Huan and Ling. Which judgment is superior? Some compared themselves to Emperor Wenxuan; others felt ashamed of themselves beside King Nan and Emperor Xian. Whose assessment was sound? Of one who could not be made clear by settling or turbid by stirring, how does his worth compare with Master Yan’s? Of one who promoted the worthy, employed the capable, readied weapons, and trained soldiers, how does his ability compare with Zifang’s? Examine and assess…

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
以論賢其材智之短長莫逃原心以
量德其人品之高下易見若徒因仍
於古人之言摹稜於臧否之際胷次
略無定見何足以尚論古人
問國用取給於東南財賦必資於漕運此
古今之通論也然唐虞之時江淅無
聞禹貢之書漕運不錄何歟三代而
下城穿邦溝湖通射陽其民固未甚
病也秦又有負海之粟三十鍾而致
===
一石何歟關東之漕僅數十萬石尋
而益至百餘萬石其漕亦未甚費也
其後既益為四百萬石又益為六百
萬石何歟朓巾置酒倚辦之急者何
人浙河入渭講畫之詳者何代閉口
之制何如孰變為擣氷轉般之法何
似孰變為直達開會通河以代海運
便矣何時而後淤疏通惠河以免陸
運當矣何為而隨廢至我
punctuated:
以論賢，其材智之短長莫逃；原心以量德，其人品之高下易見。若徒因仍於古人之言，摹稜於臧否之際，胷次略無定見，何足以尚論古人？

問：國用取給於東南，財賦必資於漕運，此古今之通論也。然唐虞之時，江淅無聞；禹貢之書，漕運不錄，何歟？三代而下，城穿邦溝，湖通射陽，其民固未甚病也。秦又有負海之粟，三十鍾而致一石，何歟？關東之漕僅數十萬石，尋而益至百餘萬石，其漕亦未甚費也。其後既益為四百萬石，又益為六百萬石，何歟？朓巾置酒，倚辦之急者何人？浙河入渭，講畫之詳者何代？閉口之制何如，孰變為擣氷？轉般之法何似，孰變為直達？開會通河以代海運，便矣，何時而後淤？疏通惠河以免陸運，當矣，何為而隨廢？至我
translation_en:
…to assess worthy men, so that neither the strengths nor the weaknesses of their ability and intelligence can escape scrutiny; probe their motives to gauge their virtue, and the relative standing of their character becomes readily apparent. If one merely follows the words of earlier writers and equivocates between praise and blame, without any settled judgment in one’s own mind, how can one adequately appraise the men of antiquity?

Question: That state expenditure is supplied by the southeast, and that fiscal revenues necessarily depend on grain transport by water, is a proposition accepted both past and present. Yet in the age of Tang and Yu, nothing was heard of Jiang and Zhe [?], and the Tribute of Yu contains no record of grain transport by water. Why is this? After the Three Dynasties, a city cut the Bang Canal [?], and a lake was connected to Sheyang [?]; the people certainly did not yet suffer greatly from this. Under the Qin, however, of thirty zhong of grain from the coastal regions, only one shi arrived. Why was this?

Grain shipped from east of the passes amounted to only several hundred thousand shi, and before long increased to over a million shi; its transport was still not excessively costly. Subsequently it increased to four million shi, and then again to six million shi. Why was this? In the episode of ‘tiao jin’ [?] and the setting out of wine, who urgently relied on the task’s completion? In what dynasty were the plans for proceeding along the river into the Wei [?] discussed in such detail? What was the system of ‘closing the mouths,’ and who changed it to ‘breaking the ice’? What was the method of transport by successive transshipment, and who changed it to direct delivery?

Opening the Huitong Canal to replace sea transport was convenient; after what time did it silt up? Dredging the Tonghui Canal to avoid overland transport was appropriate; why was it subsequently abandoned? Coming down to our …

title: 弘治八年山東鄉試錄
text:
朝
太祖高皇帝定鼎金陵東南財賦如探囊物
太宗文皇帝駐蹕燕京初猶海運何時而罷然
自古運河之水不通黃河近年黃河近黃陵
岡一決而安平鎮口遂開運舟經口
或有不虞黃河入運亦得其力或謂
黃陵岡不塞則安平鎮口不得收功
今兩口既塞功甚偉矣但天雨或不
時未免淺阻之患不可憂耶或謂不
必強塞安平鎮而但旋脩海運計亦
似矣但舟師非素習未免風波之險
又何策耶諸生長育齊魯博考圖籍
漕河之法目見而心融者幸明言之
以觀用世之學
punctuated: 朝，太祖高皇帝定鼎金陵，東南財賦如探囊物。太宗文皇帝駐蹕燕京，初猶海運，何時而罷？然自古運河之水不通黃河，近年黃河近黃陵岡一決，而安平鎮口遂開。運舟經口，或有不虞；黃河入運，亦得其力。或謂黃陵岡不塞，則安平鎮口不得收功。今兩口既塞，功甚偉矣，但天雨或不時，未免淺阻之患，不可憂耶？或謂不必強塞安平鎮，而但旋脩海運，計亦似矣。但舟師非素習，未免風波之險，又何策耶？諸生長育齊魯，博考圖籍，漕河之法，目見而心融者，幸明言之，以觀用世之學。
translation_en: …under our dynasty, Emperor Taizu Gao established his capital at Jinling, and the revenues of the southeast were as readily accessible as objects taken from a bag. Emperor Taizong Wen took up residence at Yanjing; at first, grain was still transported by sea. When was this discontinued? From ancient times, however, the waters of the Grand Canal had not communicated with the Yellow River. In recent years, the Yellow River breached its banks near Huanglinggang, whereupon an opening formed at Anpingzhen. Grain vessels passing through this opening might encounter unforeseen dangers; yet the Yellow River’s entry into the canal also supplied water that aided transport. Some maintained that unless the breach at Huanglinggang was closed, work at the opening at Anpingzhen could not succeed. Now both openings have been closed—a very great achievement. But if rain does not come at the proper time, the danger of shallows obstructing passage remains unavoidable. Is this not cause for concern? Some maintain that there is no need to insist on closing the opening at Anpingzhen, and that we should simply proceed to restore sea transport. This plan, too, seems plausible. But since the crews lack habitual practice, the dangers of wind and waves would be unavoidable. What further measures could be taken? You students have grown up in the lands of Qi and Lu and have studied maps and writings extensively. Please explain clearly what you have personally observed and thoroughly understood concerning the methods of canal grain transport, so that we may judge the learning you would bring to public service.
